crossRefs.note: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.
He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.
The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who…
It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like…
Arise, Yahweh, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded…
Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.
“Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall…

translations.web: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.
translations.bsb: Like one waking from a dream, so You, O Lord, awaken and despise their form.
translations.kjv: As a dream when one awaketh; so, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
translations.asv: As a dream when one awaketh, So, O Lord, when thou awakest, thou wilt despise their image.
